answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond that unlocks slowly, like a falcon circling before it dives: newcomers enter a garden of low-value tasks where peers check each delivery, and only honest completions raise their trust weight. An attacker spawning thousands of identities pays real money and time, because each fake must bond funds and spend weeks doing verified work before touching valuable jobs, while one proven fraud burns the bond and resets that identity to zero, so shale-thin fake reputations crumble before they can profit.
